text: {"assertions":["A lock timeout issue in migration 0042 was affecting only clients pinned to the v1 SDK.","The root cause of the lock timeout was a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown.","The fix was implemented in PR #1454 on the fix/lock-timeout-1 branch by removing the listener on teardown and adding a test assertion.","The issue could be reproduced by running migration 0042 against a loaded table, which manifested as a lock wait exceeding the statement timeout.","Memory usage improved from climbing past 1 GB to settling at 918 MB after the fix was applied.","The migration dry run in CI serves as the covering check to verify this issue is resolved."]}
